headline: Skip the group run; recover from Wednesday’s long run
summary: Wednesday’s 11.12 km run added load 169 on a prescribed rest day. Readiness is low at 39, recovery time is 35h 06m, and acute load is 1.3 times chronic load. Rest from running and cycling today.

yesterday.title: Long run on a prescribed rest day
yesterday.summary: Garmin recorded an 11.12 km run in 1h 04m 55s at 5:50/km, average HR 151, maximum HR 172 and load 169.
yesterday.prescribed: Rest from running and cycling; optional 20–30 minutes of relaxed walking and gentle mobility.
yesterday.completed: Running · 11.12 km · 1h 04m 55s · 5:50/km · average HR 151 · maximum HR 172 · load 169 · aerobic effect 4.0 · anaerobic effect 0.0. Garmin classified the activity as aerobic base.
yesterday.adherence_assessment: Did not follow. A long run was recorded despite the prescribed rest day.
adherence_evidence: The 21 October report prescribed rest from running and cycling.
Garmin recorded the run on 21 October in Sydney time.
adherence_caveats: Garmin does not identify the heart-rate sensor source in the available summary.

environment.humidity_dew_point_context: A reliable route-time Sydney humidity/dew-point estimate was not available.
environment.heat_impact_interpretation: The warm device reading provides context only; no heat effect is inferred.
environment.limitations: Device temperature may differ from shaded ambient temperature.

recommendation.title: Rest from running and cycling today
details: Optional: 20–30 minutes of relaxed walking at RPE 1–2, plus gentle mobility.
No tempo, intervals, hills or make-up mileage.
recommendation.alternative: Complete rest if tired, sore or unwell; walking is optional.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop for pain that changes gait, illness, unusual fatigue or dizziness. Seek urgent care for chest pain, fainting or severe breathlessness.

signals.label: Low readiness
signals.interpretation: Recovery is not sufficient for another structured run today.

signals.label: Recovery timer
signals.interpretation: This estimates readiness for another hard effort; together with yesterday’s run, it supports rest today.

signals.label: Elevated recent load
signals.interpretation: Yesterday’s load 169 pushed acute load higher, so adding the group run would compress recovery.

caveats: Device measurements and classifications are Garmin data; the recommendation is coaching judgment.
Garmin’s recovery timer estimates readiness for another hard effort; it is not a ban on all movement.
Current symptoms and medical advice override device scores.

run_assessments.assessment: did_not_follow — 11.12 km in 1h 04m 55s (5:50/km), average HR 151, maximum HR 172, load 169, aerobic effect 4.0 and anaerobic effect 0.0. Garmin classified the activity as aerobic base and recorded 21–29°C. The prescribed session was rest from running and cycling.
